human_domain_review.method: Four 25-image contact sheets reviewed, with converted IC bounding-box overlays visible on all images
human_domain_review.result: All images show populated PCB boards; no bare boards, breadboards, isolated components, or loose-component scenes identified.

training_scope: Single class integrated_circuit only. Other component classes are intentionally outside this experiment contract.
board_grouping_policy: Publisher source pcb<ID> directory retained as board_id
split_policy: All images from a source board ID remain in exactly one split
